scope: Every method-case record whose backend status is solver_error receives up to two cold repetitions of the identical five-iteration candidate search. Verified or normally completed searches are not repeated.
reason: Distinguish backend numerical failures from completed recourse searches; the same rule applies to M1, M4-N and M4.
inputs: Original source/load trajectory, frozen first-stage quota, industrial mode scope, initial seed and search settings are unchanged.
storage: Initial records are immutable. Repetitions are saved separately under oos_numerical_retry; unresolved repetitions remain in the denominator.
